# Cheddr Engineering Standards

Follow the standards in AGENTS.md at the project root.

Key principles:
- Classify the request first (question/planning/review/bug/implementation/investigation)
- Convention baseline before any review — sample existing files, cite them
- Laziness ladder: does this need to exist? Reuse? Stdlib? One line?
- Every finding must cite existing code. No cite = opinion.
- Test gate: what behavior does this protect? What regression fails?
- Verification: plan → change → verify → ready. Human commits.
- Reviews save locally, never auto-post to GitHub.
